sourcesReliedOn.title: On Torque and Tumbling in Swimming Escherichia coli
sourcesReliedOn.supports: Opened publisher full text. Introduction and Fig. 7 discussion distinguish CCW normal left-handed filaments from CW right-handed semicoiled filaments. Semicoiled has approximately half the normal pitch at the same amplitude; a reversed filament can leave and then rejoin the bundle.

sourcesReliedOn.title: Signal-Dependent Phosphorylation of the Membrane-Bound NarX Two-Component Sensor-Transmitter Protein of Escherichia coli
sourcesReliedOn.supports: Opened publisher full text. Introduction, NarL phosphotransfer results and Fig. 6 identify periplasmic sensing, cytoplasmic ATP-dependent covalent phosphorylation of membrane-associated NarX, transfer from NarX protein to NarL, and nonzero basal activity.

sourcesReliedOn.title: Reversible Acyl-Homoserine Lactone Binding to Purified Vibrio fischeri LuxR Protein
sourcesReliedOn.supports: Opened publisher full text. Purified LuxR binds lux-box DNA in a 3OC6-HSL-dependent manner; DNase protection and transcription assays support DNA binding before transcriptional activation. C-terminal helix-turn-helix mediates DNA binding; dilution can reverse activation.
